## Outcome

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the issue and acceptance criteria.

## Evidence

List tests and actual results, user-visible behavior proof, and any remaining limitations.

## Independent review

Record reviewer identity/family, exact reviewed head, verdict, findings and resolutions. The maintainer sets the independent-review status only after verifying this evidence.

## Closeout

After merge: verify main, reconcile the linked issue, remove clean merged worktree/branches and update the epic. Do not mark release work complete at merge alone.
